At this point, all I could think about was how much of a failure I was because I couldn't help bring my girlfriend back from her familial responsibilities.

I had the chance to pull myself up from my bad situation, because tons of friends had offered to help me out, but I refused. I did not want to be someone else's burden. At the time, I rather felt that everyone would have been happier without me on this Earth because in my mind, I had failed in everything I had set out to do.

I had the gun in my hand. I had the bullets loaded. The trigger was pulled back and the sights had its target cold. With only one step left to end my time, I was stopped by my computer which had chimed to indicate an Email had arrived for me. To this day, I couldn't tell you why I looked up. Though many people will tell you that it was the "hand of God" acting in me, but I'd like to think it was just habit.
